lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of low-contrast, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows across the mid-flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature with a sharp vertical luminance gradient—characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge—traversing the upper third of the visible lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin demonstrates a significantly higher spatial density of small-diameter, high-luminance pixels compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs observed on the main lateral body flank.
